name: trustnet
description: TrustNet - a reputation-first social platform where trust is computed from evidence, not claimed.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && node scripts/copy-client-build.js
scripts.render-start: npm run seed --prefix server && npm start --prefix server
